description: Single source of truth for the random-sample verifier. Both engines (sample_core.py and sample_core.js) interpret these schemas, formulas, and totals; neither hard-codes claim arithmetic.

sample_algorithm.name: sha256-rank/v1
sample_algorithm.description: score(id) = SHA-256(UTF-8(domain + '|' + seed + '|' + id)) read as a big-endian integer; the sample is the sample_size identifiers with the smallest (score, id). Identifiers are lowercase. Every subset of the requested size is equally likely, the sample size is never reduced, and the same seed and population always give the same sample.

row_checks.title: Native claim uses the pinned cutoff blocks and price metadata
row_checks.explain: The claim row was not computed at the published cutoff blocks (or with the published display price), so it cannot belong to this migration snapshot.

row_checks.title: Native claim address_or_secure_key equals the resolved address
row_checks.explain: A resolved row must name its address in address_or_secure_key; a mismatch means the identity columns disagree.

row_checks.title: liquid_total_atto = liquid_shard0_atto + liquid_shard1_atto (native claims)
row_checks.explain: The liquid total must be exactly the shard-0 balance plus the shard-1 balance.

row_checks.title: wallet_airdrop_atto = liquid + pending undelegation + unclaimed reward + pending cross-shard (native claims)
row_checks.explain: The direct-wallet amount must be every non-staked native component added together; active stake is excluded because it goes to a validator vault.

row_checks.title: staked_to_vault_atto = active_staked_or_delegated_atto (native claims)
row_checks.explain: Only active stake or delegation moves to a validator vault, and all of it does.

row_checks.title: total_claim_atto = wallet_airdrop_atto + staked_to_vault_atto (native claims)
row_checks.explain: The total claim must be exactly the wallet part plus the vault part.

row_checks.title: USD display values are derived exactly from the atto integers
row_checks.explain: USD columns are for display only; they must be the exact product of the integer amount and the published price.

row_checks.title: Current claim uses the pinned cutoff blocks and price metadata
row_checks.explain: The claim row was not computed at the published cutoff blocks (or with the published display price).

row_checks.title: Current claim address_or_secure_key equals the resolved address
row_checks.explain: A resolved row must name its address in address_or_secure_key.

row_checks.title: liquid_total_atto = liquid_shard0_atto + liquid_shard1_atto
row_checks.explain: The liquid total must be exactly the shard-0 balance plus the shard-1 balance.

row_checks.title: native_wallet_airdrop_atto = liquid_shard0 + liquid_shard1 + pending_undelegation + unclaimed_staking_reward + pending_cross_shard
row_checks.explain: The native wallet amount must be every non-staked native component added together.

row_checks.title: staked_to_vault_atto = active_staked_or_delegated_atto
row_checks.explain: Only active stake or delegation moves to a validator vault, and all of it does.

row_checks.title: native_total_claim_atto = native_wallet_airdrop_atto + staked_to_vault_atto
row_checks.explain: The native claim must be the native wallet part plus the vault part.

row_checks.title: qualification_total_atto = native_total_claim_atto + wone_balance_atto
row_checks.explain: The amount tested against the 1,000 ONE threshold must be the native claim plus the cutoff WONE balance.

row_checks.title: wone_airdrop_atto follows the eligibility policy (full WONE balance if qualifying or a confirmed exchange wallet, otherwise zero)
row_checks.explain: WONE is added to the wallet amount only for rows at or above 1,000 ONE or for confirmed exchange wallets; a below-threshold row that is not an exchange wallet must receive no WONE.

row_checks.title: wallet_airdrop_atto = native_wallet_airdrop_atto + wone_airdrop_atto
row_checks.explain: The wallet amount must be the native wallet part plus any WONE airdrop.

row_checks.title: total_claim_atto = wallet_airdrop_atto + staked_to_vault_atto
row_checks.explain: The total claim must be exactly the wallet part plus the vault part.

row_checks.title: USD display values are derived exactly from the atto integers
row_checks.explain: USD columns are for display only; they must be the exact product of the integer amount and the published price.

row_checks.title: An excluded WONE holder has no WONE balance or WONE airdrop in the current claim
row_checks.explain: Addresses in the overlay summary's excluded_addresses_requested (the WONE contract, the LayerZero NativeOFT contracts, and any other reviewed exclusion) do not qualify with, or receive, WONE.

row_checks.title: The WONE contract receives no WONE allocation for its own balance
row_checks.explain: WONE held by the WONE contract itself is excluded from recipient delivery.

row_checks.title: Native claim fields are carried unchanged into the current claim
row_checks.explain: The WONE overlay may only add WONE fields; it must not change any native component, identity, or cutoff metadata.

row_checks.title: native_wallet_airdrop_atto and native_total_claim_atto equal the native claim's wallet and total
row_checks.explain: The current claim's native part must be exactly the native claim ledger's wallet and total.

row_checks.title: A row with no native claim is a WONE-only row with zero native components and a positive WONE balance
row_checks.explain: Rows absent from the native ledger may only be added for WONE holders who qualify or belong to a confirmed exchange inventory, and they carry no native balance.

row_checks.title: wone_balance_atto matches the WONE holder census (zero for excluded holders)
row_checks.explain: The WONE balance used for qualification must be the holder's balance in the cutoff WONE census, or zero for an address in the overlay summary's exclusion set.

row_checks.title: WONE census decimal balance is derived exactly from the atto integer
row_checks.explain: The census wone_balance column is a display rendering of wone_balance_atto.

row_checks.title: staked_to_vault_atto equals the sum of this delegator's per-validator delegations
row_checks.explain: The staked amount must be exactly covered by active delegations to specific validator vaults.

row_checks.title: Exchange inventory membership and exchange manual-delivery routes agree
row_checks.explain: Every wallet in a confirmed exchange inventory with a positive claim must have manual-delivery routes, and no other wallet may.

row_checks.title: Row appears in the eligibility output exactly when qualification_total_atto >= 1,000 ONE
row_checks.explain: The inclusive threshold (>= 1,000 ONE in exact atto units) decides eligibility; a qualifying row must appear once and a non-qualifying row must not appear.

row_checks.title: Eligibility row carries the same identity and claim components
row_checks.explain: Eligibility classification must not change any claim amount.

row_checks.title: Eligibility category agrees with the stage policy's classification and routing category
row_checks.explain: An automatic row must be a wallet, a genuine contract must have gone through contract review or exclusion, and an exchange/manual row must have been excluded from automatic delivery.

row_checks.title: Row appears in the migration-stage policy exactly when it qualifies
row_checks.explain: The stage policy covers every snapshot-qualifying row and no other row.

row_checks.title: Stage policy uses the same qualification total and gross claim
row_checks.explain: The stage policy must start from exactly the current claim for this secure key and address.

row_checks.title: migration_allocation = gross - existing non-issuance - retained cap - WONE source offset - reviewed-contract non-issuance
row_checks.explain: Every amount removed from the gross claim must be an explicit, reviewed deduction.

row_checks.title: migration_wallet_allocation + migration_staked_to_vault = migration_allocation; contract non-issuance components close
row_checks.explain: The wallet and vault parts of the allocation must add up to the allocation.

row_checks.title: Deductions come out of the wallet part first, then the vault part
row_checks.explain: The wallet/vault split of the allocation must follow the documented rule (deductions reduce the direct wallet amount before vault shares).

row_checks.title: Issuance treatment and migration stage agree with the remaining allocation
row_checks.explain: A row with a remaining allocation must be issued in a stage; a row with nothing left must be not_issued and have no stage.

row_checks.title: Only the WONE contract has a WONE source offset
row_checks.explain: The WONE reserve offset applies only to the WONE contract's own native balance.

row_checks.title: Last activity is at or before the requested cutoff
row_checks.explain: Activity is capped at the cutoff; a later timestamp means post-cutoff data leaked into the stage decision.

row_checks.title: Initial-stage row is a wallet with activity in the six-month window and >= 1,000 ONE after incident deductions
row_checks.explain: The initial stage is limited to wallets active since 2026-03-10T14:00:00Z whose legitimate (post-incident-deduction) qualification is still at least 1,000 ONE.

row_checks.title: Wallet stage follows activity and the post-deduction threshold
row_checks.explain: An active wallet that still meets the threshold after incident deductions must be initial; every other wallet with an allocation must be deferred.

row_checks.title: Contract classification, routing category, and policy group agree
row_checks.explain: Genuine contracts are routed by contract policy: multisig, 1wallet and LayerZero collateral are next stage; SmartVault and other reviewed contracts are not issued.

row_checks.title: Every routing exception for this secure key names the same address
row_checks.explain: A routing row whose source address does not match the claim's address would move someone else's allocation.

row_checks.title: Routing treatment, destination status, and stage are consistent
row_checks.explain: ready/hold rows are issued, not_issuing rows are not issued, redistributed rows are the WONE source offset, and exchange rows are delivered manually from the 2050 reserve in the exchange_manual stage.

row_checks.title: Terminal routes have no destination; ready routes have one
row_checks.explain: not_issuing and redistributed are terminal outcomes with no recipient; a ready route must name its recipient; vault-share routes must name the validator vault.

row_checks.title: Non-exchange routing rows carry the stage policy's migration stage
row_checks.explain: A routing row that names a different stage than the stage policy is a conflicting destination decision.

row_checks.title: Not-issued plus redistributed routes equal the stage policy's deductions
row_checks.explain: Every deduction in the stage policy must be backed by an explicit not_issuing or redistributed route of the same amount, and no extra amount may be withheld.

row_checks.title: Exchange manual-delivery routes cover the whole claim (after any non-issuance)
row_checks.explain: An exchange wallet's complete entitlement (native ONE, WONE and delegated principal) is delivered manually; routes must add up to the full claim.

row_checks.title: An initial validator wallet has an explicit same-address wallet exception
row_checks.explain: Validator accounts are code-bearing, so their delivery must be an explicit, reviewed exception rather than the implicit ordinary-wallet default.

row_checks.title: Wallet allocation equals the stage policy's wallet part for initial issued rows, and is empty otherwise
row_checks.explain: Only initial-stage issued rows (excluding exchange wallets, which are delivered manually) receive wallet tokens in this stage, and they receive exactly their wallet allocation.

row_checks.title: Wallet allocation rows name the same source address
row_checks.explain: A wallet allocation row whose source address differs from the claim's address is attached to the wrong account.

row_checks.title: Every ready wallet allocation names a destination address
row_checks.explain: A ready allocation without a destination cannot be paid and must be a hold instead.

row_checks.title: Implicit same-address delivery is used only for ordinary automatic wallets, to the same address
row_checks.explain: Only ordinary code-less wallets may be paid at their own address without an explicit reviewed route.

row_checks.title: Explicit wallet allocations equal the issued wallet routing exceptions
row_checks.explain: Every explicitly routed wallet amount in the allocation must come from an issued routing exception, and vice versa.

row_checks.title: Vault-share allocation equals the stage policy's staked part for initial issued rows, and is empty otherwise
row_checks.explain: Only initial-stage issued rows receive vault shares in this stage, and exactly their staked allocation.

row_checks.title: Vault-share rows name the same source address; implicit shares go to the same address
row_checks.explain: Vault shares must belong to this claim's account, and implicit shares may only go to that same account.

row_checks.title: The claim appears once in the cutoff snapshot as a ledger row
row_checks.explain: Every row of the current claim ledger must appear exactly once in the published snapshot, marked native_ledger when it has a native claim and wone_only_ledger otherwise.

row_checks.title: Snapshot balances equal the claim components
row_checks.explain: The published snapshot must show the same liquid, stake (self-stake plus delegation), undelegation, reward, cross-shard, and native total amounts as the claim that is delivered.

row_checks.title: Snapshot totals add up (native total, total balance, non-issuing, incident deduction)
row_checks.explain: The snapshot's own totals must equal the sum of their parts, exactly as its README defines them.

row_checks.title: Incident deduction scope matches the deduction relative to the native total
row_checks.explain: An incident deduction is none when zero, full when it takes the whole native total, and partial otherwise.

row_checks.title: Snapshot WONE equals the claim's WONE, except for listed ledger overrides
row_checks.explain: The snapshot reports actual cutoff WONE balances; it may differ from the claim only for excluded addresses whose WONE the claim records as zero, and only when the snapshot summary lists them in ledger_wone_overrides.

row_checks.title: Snapshot WONE equals the WONE holder census
row_checks.explain: The snapshot's WONE column is the actual cutoff balance from the holder census.

row_checks.title: Snapshot qualification, WONE airdrop, exchange flag, stage, and treatment match the migration
row_checks.explain: The published policy columns must agree with the delivered claim: exchange wallets are exchange_manual / manual_from_reserve, qualified rows carry the stage policy's stage and treatment, and other rows have neither.

row_checks.title: Snapshot migration allocation, reviewed-contract non-issuance, and WONE reserve match the stage policy
row_checks.explain: Only qualified rows have a migration allocation, and the reviewed-contract and WONE-reserve amounts must be the stage policy's.

row_checks.title: WONE not delivered equals the WONE of a below-threshold, non-exchange row
row_checks.explain: WONE is not delivered in this migration only when the row is below the combined 1,000 ONE threshold and is not an exchange wallet.

row_checks.title: Snapshot labels match the non-issuing amounts they explain
row_checks.explain: wone-reserve, wone-below-threshold, and excluded-smartvault / excluded-contract labels appear exactly when the matching non-issuing amount is positive.

row_checks.title: Snapshot contract and validator flags agree with the stage classification and activity coverage
row_checks.explain: Validators are not contracts, reviewed genuine contracts have code, validator wallets are registered validators, and activity is collected exactly for addresses holding at least 1 ONE.

row_checks.title: Snapshot labels are known labels or incident slugs, and incident slugs match the related incidents
row_checks.explain: special_label may only contain the documented labels and dated incident slugs; an incident role is given exactly when a related incident is, and any incident deduction names its incident.

row_checks.title: Snapshot activity details are present exactly when the activity time is
row_checks.explain: A last-signed or last-inbound transaction is recorded completely (time, shard, hash, and type or sender) or not at all, and no activity is recorded for addresses whose activity was not collected.

row_checks.title: snapshot_breakdown labels are the full snapshot's labels, without victim-only incident slugs
row_checks.explain: Public labels must be exactly the full snapshot's labels, except that incident slugs coming only from a reported-victim role are left out.

row_checks.title: snapshot_public labels are the full snapshot's labels, without victim-only incident slugs
row_checks.explain: Public labels must be exactly the full snapshot's labels, except that incident slugs coming only from a reported-victim role are left out.

row_checks.title: snapshot_small labels are the full snapshot's labels, without victim-only incident slugs
row_checks.explain: Public labels must be exactly the full snapshot's labels, except that incident slugs coming only from a reported-victim role are left out.

row_checks.title: Snapshot nonces match the claim's cutoff nonces where both are measured
row_checks.explain: A cutoff nonce is a single value; two files that both measured it must agree.

row_checks.title: Row is in snapshot_breakdown exactly when its exact total balance meets the file's minimum
row_checks.explain: Public files include an address only when its exact total, before rounding, is at least the file's minimum (1 ONE, or 10 ONE for the small file).

row_checks.title: snapshot_breakdown whole-ONE amounts and dates are derived exactly from the full snapshot
row_checks.explain: Public amounts are the exact atto values rounded half up to whole ONE, and dates are the UTC times as YYYYMMDD.

row_checks.title: Row is in snapshot_public exactly when its exact total balance meets the file's minimum
row_checks.explain: Public files include an address only when its exact total, before rounding, is at least the file's minimum (1 ONE, or 10 ONE for the small file).

row_checks.title: snapshot_public whole-ONE amounts and dates are derived exactly from the full snapshot
row_checks.explain: Public amounts are the exact atto values rounded half up to whole ONE, and dates are the UTC times as YYYYMMDD.

row_checks.title: Row is in snapshot_small exactly when its exact total balance meets the file's minimum
row_checks.explain: Public files include an address only when its exact total, before rounding, is at least the file's minimum (1 ONE, or 10 ONE for the small file).

row_checks.title: snapshot_small whole-ONE amounts and dates are derived exactly from the full snapshot
row_checks.explain: Public amounts are the exact atto values rounded half up to whole ONE, and dates are the UTC times as YYYYMMDD.
